product_family: Low-code AI builder for RAG applications and AI agents; available as open-source, self-hosted, or cloud-managed service on IBM watsonx platform

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type I
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of SOC 2 Type I certification on langflow.org, docs.langflow.org, or IBM product pages

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of SOC 2 Type II certification on langflow.org, docs.langflow.org, or IBM product pages

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification documented in Langflow security pages or IBM watsonx documentation

certifications.name: ISO 27018 (Cloud PII)
certifications.proof_quote: IBM Watson AI services hold ISO 27018, but Langflow as a product does not independently claim this certification

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Langflow documentation recommends GDPR best practices but does not claim GDPR compliance certification or Data Processing Agreement

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No evidence of HIPAA compliance or certification; IBM Aspera supports HIPAA but Langflow product does not

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification

privacy.privacy_policy_url: Not found on langflow.org; privacy link redirects to IBM privacy statement
privacy.ai_training_note: No explicit policy found regarding training on customer data. When users connect external LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.), data flows to those providers' APIs per their terms. Self-hosted instances do not send data externally.
privacy.data_region: Self-hosted: user-controlled; Cloud: IBM watsonx infrastructure (exact regions not publicly documented for Langflow)

security.name: Application-Level Isolation
security.value: NOT ENFORCED - Langflow explicitly states it 'neither enforces isolation between users within a single Langflow process, nor restricts access to the local disk or network resources'

security.name: Multi-Tenant Deployment Security
security.value: RELIES ON INFRASTRUCTURE - Langflow defers to infrastructure-level security controls; application does not enforce tenant isolation

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: Recommended but not enforced by application; users must implement HTTPS/TLS at infrastructure level

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: Recommended best practice; Langflow stores encrypted key references but relies on deployment environment

security.name: API Key Management
security.value: Optional LANGFLOW_REMOVE_API_KEYS flag allows omitting keys from database; environment variables recommended for secure storage

security.name: Authentication
security.value: Vulnerable - Multiple CVEs show unauthenticated remote code execution via public build endpoints (CVE-2026-33017, CVE-2025-3248)

security.name: Authorization Bypass
security.value: Vulnerable - CVE-2025-34291 allows unauthenticated cross-user MCP access and tool execution via CORS/CSRF bypass (CVSS 9.4)

security.name: Path Traversal
security.value: Previously vulnerable - CVE-2026-5027 (CVSS 8.8) in file upload endpoint, patched in v1.9.0 (April 2026)

security.name: Vulnerability Disclosure
security.value: HackerOne-based responsible disclosure; 7-day response target; public advisories on GitHub

products.name: Langflow (Open Source)
products.data_scope: User-controlled (fully on-premises); zero data sent to Langflow vendors if self-hosted
products.notes: Available on GitHub (MIT License); can be deployed locally or on any infrastructure. No vendor involvement in data handling for self-hosted deployments. Known security vulnerabilities documented in public advisories.

products.name: Langflow Cloud
products.data_scope: Langflow flows, integrations, and connected API credentials stored on Langflow Cloud infrastructure
products.notes: Hosted cloud offering for rapid prototyping and deployment. Data residency and compliance posture not clearly documented. Inherits IBM watsonx governance controls but application-level isolation NOT enforced.

products.name: Langflow on IBM watsonx Orchestrate
products.data_scope: Agents, flows, governance metadata on IBM Cloud infrastructure
products.notes: Enterprise edition with SSO, RBAC, audit trails, and lifecycle management. Adds governance layer but underlying Langflow isolation issues remain. IBM watsonx provides compliance wrapper but Langflow itself has documented security gaps.

compare.pricing_model: Free (open source) | Free tier cloud | Paid cloud/enterprise tiers (IBM watsonx)
compare.data_residency: User-controlled for self-hosted; unspecified for cloud (IBM Cloud regions, likely US-based)

flags: NO FORMAL SECURITY CERTIFICATIONS - Langflow has zero documented SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, or HIPAA certifications; IBM watsonx certification does not directly apply to the Langflow product itself

CRITICAL VULNERABILITIES - Multiple recent CVEs with active exploitation: CVE-2026-33017 (unauthenticated RCE exploited within 20 hours of disclosure), CVE-2025-34291 (CORS/CSRF bypass, CVSS 9.4), CVE-2026-5027 (path traversal)
NO APPLICATION-LEVEL ISOLATION - Langflow explicitly does not enforce multi-tenant isolation or restrict disk/network access; relies entirely on infrastructure-level controls
ACTIVE EXPLOITATION - Approximately 7,000 exposed Langflow instances found on the internet actively being exploited as of June 2026; cryptocurrency mining and ransomware campaigns confirmed
MISSING LEGAL DOCUMENTS - No formal privacy policy, terms of service, or data processing agreement found on langflow.org; privacy link redirects to IBM's generic privacy statement
INCOMPLETE COMPLIANCE TRANSPARENCY - Cloud service offerings (Langflow Cloud, watsonx integration) lack documented compliance posture; no data residency guarantees published
CISA KEV LISTED - CVE-2025-3248 added to CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog in May 2025; indicates active, weaponized exploitation
IDENTITY VERIFICATION - Confirmed IBM acquisition of DataStax (including Langflow) but IBM product pages return 403 Forbidden; unclear if Langflow is offered as standalone or only via watsonx
